summary:
Four Codex handoff branches in html-portfolio (2026-09-07..09). All four branch from origin/codex/vyakti-completion@6260611e and share an octopus merge-base, 57eda53a, which is VC plus 159 commits. Per-branch delta beyond that base: handoff-processing204 +4, handoff-voice-comparison106 +8 (7 shared with handoff206, plus the unique 0b47b2b8), handoff206 +20, handoff-history-20260909 +22. The history branch is an archive-only octopus merge whose tree equals handoff206@31833cdf; its job is to keep historical objects reachable.
The product is Vyakti, an expert 'clone' (Feed it -> Meet it -> Deploy it). It runs Azure-only with Hindi/Hinglish/English as priorities. Range changes: 1,387 files, ~253k insertions, 364 new rejections, 348 decisions, 419 measurements.
What was built: an expert text Room on Azure Foundry (gpt-4.1-mini, Mistral-Large-3, gpt-5.6-terra dialogue lane) with teacher-sheet publication, private rehearsal and correction loops. Also an experience compiler (cited candidates, owner decisions, a 24h observable-expression ledger that never claims emotion), learner communication memory (language/script/depth, migration 162, Account correct/forget UI), an 8-stage Azure audio processing DAG with GPU allocation budget windows (migration 161), a Hindi TTS text frontend, Azure short and fast ASR adapters, safe KaTeX math rendering, an Azure-only egress policy, an Azure web adapter (not deployed), and a large release gate suite.
Voice106 ran Chatterbox Multilingual V3 vs VoxCPM2 as Azure T4 Manual Jobs: 12/12 clips verified, warm RTF ~0.77 vs ~2.14, 0 human ratings, no winner. A blind A/B listening page was packaged.
Memory trial actual213 (7 real calls, 25,595 microUSD): the Roman Hinglish preference was recalled and forget worked, but the corrected-Hindi reply came back entirely English. The fix (drop the conflicting teacher language default) was never tested live.
The handoff explicitly states NOT production-ready. The owner's primary outcomes, a real signed-in journey and owner voice likeness, were never verified. The handoff names over-coordination and bookkeeping as the failure.
For Taxila the highest value is in evaluation instruments (listening page/library, switch-adjacent WER, held-out physics TTS prompts, teaching-answer rubric) and portable code (Foundry strict-JSON adapter, delivery-plan schema, learner-diagnosis prompt shape, communication-preference contract, safe KaTeX, egress guard, spend ledger, closed expression feature set).
The negative results are equally valuable: persona post-processing destroyed educational content; persona defaults beat saved learner preferences; appended prompt policies did not change outputs; token-level code-switch TTS fan-out wrecked prosody; scale-to-zero T4 TTS is far from realtime.

A durable window state machine runs start_claimed -> running -> stop_requested -> terminal_observed. The detached observer may observe, recover or stop, but never retries generation or start.

assets.title: Azure AI Foundry strict-JSON chat adapter (gpt-5.6 dialect)
assets.what: POST to /models/chat/completions with strict json_schema. Endpoint must be *.services.ai.azure.com and redirects are refused. The body is streamed and capped at 512 KB, and a deadline aborts the call. Retryable statuses: 408/409/429/5xx. Usage is required and measured. For gpt-5.6-terra: max_completion_tokens 700, reasoning_effort none, an expected response-model pin, a reasoning-token sanity check and a system_fingerprint format check.

assets.title: Dialogue contract: reply + delivery plan, language precedence, learner diagnosis shape
assets.what: Output schema is {reply<=1600, delivery:{mode grounded/warm/playful/direct/repair, pace slow/natural/brisk, intensity 0-1, language_hint, nonverbals<=3 of breath/soft_laugh/pause/sigh}}, and dialogueSpeechStyle() turns the delivery into a speaking-style string. System laws cover turn language precedence and the learner diagnosis shape (observed answer -> discrepancy -> check -> brief correction; when the cause is unknown, ask one targeted question for the missing step). dangerousReply blocks OTP/password/payment requests and 'I am human'. Also surrogate-safe cleaning and a 20-turn/16k-char history cap.
assets.taxila_target: prompt-compiler + tts-voice-identity (realtime instructions) + learning/pedagogy (covert comprehension) + safety-floor
assets.notes: Adherence to the v2 laws was never measured live

assets.title: Learner communication preference contract (language/script/depth)
assets.what: Three closed fields: language english/hindi/hinglish; script roman/devanagari (never inferred from language); brevity short/detailed (which also means explanation depth). Each has a per-field scope boolean. Includes the LLM extraction rule and JSON schema with field meanings that fixed the Hindi 'vistaar se' miss. A deterministic positive grammar refuses negated, quoted or hypothetical text. Projection is newest-first per field, and a null in scope blocks older values. A DB CHECK constraint enforces the shape.

assets.title: Learner-visible memory: list / correct / retract / forget SQL

A correction inserts a new user_said fact with its own episode and supersedes the old one (t_invalid, superseded_by); there is no model call. A single item can be retracted (retracted_at), and a whole forget bumps memory_epoch. All of it is gated on memory_consent_at and age_attested_at.

Inline **bold** and `code` render; currency and Hindi stay literal; wide equations scroll accessibly.

rejections.tried: Synthesize each detected Hindi/English token run with a separate TTS call and join with 60 ms silence or crossfade
rejections.what_broke: Every switch reset seed, reference conditioning, breath and emphasis; the clip was 3.36x longer, 65.47% near-silence, ECAPA 0.434. A crossfade cannot restore co-articulation.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never split a Hinglish tutor utterance across TTS calls; keep language spans as audit metadata only.

rejections.tried: Use the identity_anchor preset (exaggeration 0.2, CFG 0.78, temperature 0.6) as the ordinary voice
rejections.what_broke: The owner heard it as flat and robotic; replaced with neutral defaults 0.5/0.5/0.8.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Identity-test presets are not teaching voices; tune expressiveness by blind listening.

rejections.tried: Reject a preview when Roman Hinglish exceeds 16 language switches
rejections.what_broke: A natural owner Hinglish paragraph was rejected before the GPU, and retries were deterministic.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Children's Hinglish is dense; do not fail closed on switch counts.

rejections.tried: Route Hindi automatically to the Hindi-specific Chatterbox pack
rejections.what_broke: It scored lower (0.832 vs 0.858, n=2); model switching did not explain the failure.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Language-specialist models are not automatically better; measure.

rejections.tried: Claim pronunciation, expression or human-likeness wins from 29 passing prompt plans, a curated orthography table or a higher ECAPA
rejections.what_broke: None of these listens to the audio; Chatterbox still takes one language tag per utterance; the owner's report of robotic speech stood.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Tutor voice acceptance needs blinded human listening.

rejections.tried: Pick 'best model' from vendor tables (Fish speaker similarity, Qwen language list, automated naturalness)
rejections.what_broke: Fish trades speaker similarity against WER; Qwen excludes Hindi; automated naturalness is not native listening.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Do not choose voice vendors from model cards.

rejections.tried: Replace the call brain with PhoneLLM because of B200/Modal latency and cost numbers
rejections.what_broke: It is an English text model with a 63.17 GB BF16 closure and no Hindi results, benchmarked on a highly utilised B200 across 88 agents.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Benchmarks from other hardware and languages do not transfer.

rejections.tried: Tell owners that more upload hours make a stronger clone
rejections.what_broke: Generation conditions on one ~10 s reference; a 109-minute lecture still sounded wrong; duration adds noise and other speakers.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Narrator voice quality comes from reference selection, not volume.

rejections.tried: Run sepformer-whamr16k separation on every recording
rejections.what_broke: Its 16 kHz Nyquist erased the 8-12 kHz identity band on a single-speaker lecture (dominant share 0.9624); this was the owner's 'not even 0.05% similar' complaint.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Bandwidth-limiting audio stages wreck voice identity; skip them when they are not needed.

rejections.tried: Use the 16 kHz scoring buffer as the delivered enrollment reference
rejections.what_broke: Only 0.46% of energy remained above 8 kHz, so the clone fell back toward the base timbre.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Score at low rate, deliver at full rate from the original.

rejections.tried: Run separation on the whole 822.72 s recording in one GPU forward pass
rejections.what_broke: It failed every attempt with voice_evidence_failed, consistent with an in-process CUDA OOM.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Window long media before GPU stages.

rejections.tried: Treat each short diarized cluster of a self-recording as a different person
rejections.what_broke: Two production primary WAVs stopped at separate with reference_window_no_candidate.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Short clean recordings need an explicit single-speaker fallback.

rejections.tried: Relax old listening-pack IDs/counts or borrow one owner reference across speakers so new packs load
rejections.what_broke: It would compare unlike recordings and serve the wrong reference player.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Scope listening cells by speaker and reference.

rejections.tried: Require equal reference and output duration
rejections.what_broke: An invented prerequisite; human comparison speech and generated utterances differ naturally.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Do not add gates without a reason.

concepts.name: Evidence hierarchy
concepts.description: Each rung is weaker than the next: transport success, source contract, offline test, structural pass, live raw output, delivered output, human judgment. No rung certifies the next.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Passing tutor evals do not prove a child learned; ECAPA or ASR scores do not prove a human-feeling voice.

concepts.name: Consumed identities / no replay
concepts.description: A paid run, holdout or migration once used is recorded as consumed; it becomes regression material, never a fresh holdout or tuning target.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Pedagogy eval sets must rotate; failed cases become regression tests.

concepts.name: Prospective rubric with raw vs delivered review
concepts.description: Write requirements before the call; judge raw model text and post-processed delivered text separately.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Many defects came from post-processing, which matters for tutor speech and on-screen modules.

concepts.name: Two output lanes
concepts.description: The persona/chat lane may strip stage directions, dashes and long bullets; the educational lane preserves brackets, LaTeX, signs, lists and identifiers.
concepts.taxila_relevance: The tutor speaks warmly but must render exact science and maths.

concepts.name: Learner communication dimensions and precedence
concepts.description: Language, script and depth are independent fields; script is never inferred from language. Precedence: explicit current request > saved > question language > persona default. A temporary override never edits memory; a conflicting default must be removed, not merely outranked.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Seed fields for the learning profile; the persona must not fight the child's profile.

concepts.name: Learner diagnosis shape
concepts.description: Observed answer or step -> supported discrepancy -> teacher check -> brief correction; when the cause is unknown, make one targeted request for the missing step; never invent the learner's working or motive.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A direct template for covert comprehension checks without quizzing.

concepts.name: Experience compiler
concepts.description: Immutable events -> short-lived observations -> source-cited candidates -> explicit decision -> versioned materialization with rollback and erasure; reuse existing authorities, never a second truth store.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Relational-OS facts about a child should be cited and parent/teacher reviewable. The reversal condition (auto-apply only if it beats review on false-write rate) gives Taxila a measurable path to automation.

concepts.name: Observable expression, not inner emotion
concepts.description: A closed set of measurable delivery mechanics with units and bounds, a 24 h TTL, dyad/turn scope and may_claim_inner_emotion=false; collect-only until calibrated.
concepts.taxila_relevance: An emotional lens for children that is DPDP-safe and non-manipulative; signals feed comprehension detection only after calibration.

concepts.name: One acoustic utterance per code-mixed sentence
concepts.description: Keep token language spans as a signed audit plan; never fan out into separate TTS calls.

concepts.name: Reference bank by delivery role
concepts.description: Neutral, explanatory classroom, energetic and calm-empathetic references, one selected per utterance; more minutes is not better conditioning.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Tutor voice and avatar delivery modes.

concepts.name: Switch-adjacent WER
concepts.description: Measure errors within +-2 tokens of language boundaries; whole-utterance WER hides code-switch failures.
concepts.taxila_relevance: The QA metric for Hinglish TTS.

concepts.name: Cold vs warm economics
concepts.description: Price scale-from-zero allocation windows separately from warm marginal work, and carrier separately; T4 self-hosted TTS RTF ~0.77-2.1 non-streaming.
concepts.taxila_relevance: 30-60 min realtime sessions need a managed realtime model (gpt-realtime), not scale-to-zero self-hosted TTS.

concepts.name: Fail-closed metering
concepts.description: Reserve -> begin -> settle; uncertain outcomes stay held; retries are never free; persist paid output before accounting.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Per-child, per-day cost caps for LLM, voice and image generation.

concepts.name: Durable idempotent intents
concepts.description: One logical request maps to one paid generation; retries only observe; regeneration needs an explicit key.
concepts.taxila_relevance: On-the-fly module, game and image generation.

concepts.name: Azure-only serving boundary
concepts.description: An egress origin allowlist plus a response-model pin; redirects refused.
concepts.taxila_relevance: DPDP: child data goes only to Azure.

concepts.name: Recoverable handoff with archive refs
concepts.description: A works/doesn't-work table, a do-not-replay list, a money ledger, SHA-256 manifests, fresh-clone recovery checks, and archive-only refs that are never merged.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Taxila context/ logging and session handoffs.
